fun_facts: Isaac Brown was a football and track-and-field star at Miami Northwestern Senior High School.
At Louisville, Isaac Brown’s third career carry went for 36 yards, and his fifth went 77 yards for a touchdown.
As a 2024 freshman, Isaac Brown was named the ACC’s best rookie and a Freshman All-American.
Isaac Brown became the first Louisville freshman to rush for more than 1,000 yards.
Against Florida State in 2026, Isaac Brown ran for a career-high 235 yards, including a 97-yard touchdown that set Louisville’s record for longest play from scrimmage.
content.high_school: Miami Northwestern Senior High School (ESPN’s recruiting profile also lists Homestead Senior High School.)

basis.reasoning: The cited ESPN passage says Brown was a football and track-and-field star, describes his third and fifth career carries, and reports his 2024 freshman recognition. Another ESPN passage says he became Louisville’s first freshman to eclipse 1,000 rushing yards. ESPN’s Florida State recap reports his 235-yard game and 97-yard touchdown, then states the run set Louisville’s longest-play-from-scrimmage record.

excerpts:
The way Ndamukong Suh dominated a double-team at Nebraska made it seem like he was the only college football player who lifted weights.

Louisville running back [Isaac Brown](https://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5079349/isaac-brown) hasn't succeeded at the level of Smith or Suh, but he's putting together a solid career. A football and track-and-field star at Miami Northwestern Senior High School, he was the ACC's best rookie and a Freshman All-American in 2024. His third career carry went for 36 yards, and his fifth went for 77 and a touchdown. He finished the year with 1,325 yards from scrimmage, 12 touchdowns and a few solid kickoff returns.
